title: support.impersonation.ended (v2)
description: A support impersonation grant was revoked. Emitted when the support actor, the impersonated customer or an administrator with support.impersonation.revoke revokes an active grant; its tokens and pending hand-offs are invalidated. Not emitted when a grant expires, when the customer opts out of support access, or when grants are revoked as a side effect (membership suspension/removal, organization suspension or deletion, session revocation, restore). org_id is always set.

data.description: Event data. All members are identifiers or state, so the minimal and standard payload forms are identical.

reason.description: Why the grant ended. Currently always "revoked"; further values may be added.

organization_id.description: Always set for this event type.
